items.text: Neuroscience career options include research, clinical research support, neurotechnology and imaging, data analysis, science writing and teaching, and most deeper roles need advanced study, so plan the degree path, build lab or data skills and keep wider routes open.
Build a base in biology and statistics, gain lab or data experience and choose between research, applied and communication routes.
Verify eligibility and avoid courses promising neurologist-style roles.
